# UNP Fiscal 2013 Figures

## Key Figures:

- **Agricultural (2012)**: $3,018 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Total Freight Revenues (2012)**: $18,111 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Total Freight Revenues (2013)**: $19,029 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Agricultural (2011)**: $3,058 million (Source: documents/report.md)

## Calculation:

As of December 31, 2012, the percent of total freight revenues from agriculture is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percent} = \left( \frac{\text{Agricultural (2012)}}{\text{Total Freight Revenues (2012)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percent} = \left( \frac{3,018}{18,111} \right) \times 100 \approx 16.66\% \]

**Note:** All figures are from the audited 10-K (documents/report.md).

As of December 31, 2012, the percent of total freight revenues from agriculture is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Percent} = \left( \frac{\text{Agricultural (2012)}}{\text{Total Freight Revenues (2012)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percent} = \left( \frac{3,018}{18,111} \right) \times 100 \approx 16.66\% \]

**Note:** All figures are from the audited 10-K (documents/report.md).
